As we usually do, I'd like to hear from the requesting teacher, our instructional technology specialist, and the business-office manager before I make a final approval decision. Please go ahead and share any relevant findings you have on the equipment, software platform, funding, and installation timeline.

transcript.text: I completed a classroom trial this week with the enrolled section, and I found that all 12 students need simultaneous stations — specifically, one laptop and one USB microphone per student. I recorded these results in my classroom planning log, but I should note that the log was not attached to the capital request, so I want to make sure this finding is on the record now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed my network and privacy review this week, and I found that the commercial cloud platform requested in the proposal cannot be used with student accounts due to our privacy and security requirements. Instead, the district-managed SoundLab EDU platform is approved and requires managed student accounts plus a security configuration record. I closed the technology review ticket this week, but it hasn't been linked to the purchasing request yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to share my findings on funding and the installation timeline. I confirmed this week that the Arts Innovation Grant will fund this project, but only up to exactly $6,800 — not the $8,000 requested from the general fund. Additionally, the grant requires that the purchase order be issued by August 20, 2026. Under the grant's purchasing sequence, the purchase order must be followed by procurement and setup, which makes September 15, 2026 the earliest feasible installation date — not September 1 as listed in the draft proposal. I received the grant award notice this week and filed it in the business-office grant folder, but I should note that the funding note has not yet been added to the proposal.
